polityNote: Basutoland (British High Commission territory) and, from 1966-10-04, the Kingdom of Lesotho. First level: the districts. Atoms are the ten districts of geoBoundaries LSO ADM1 (OpenStreetMap, 2017). Five districts no recorded change touches since the ~1944 split (Berea, Butha-Buthe, Mafeteng, Mohale's Hoek, Quthing) are drawn from the 1946 census; the four that gave land to Thaba-Tseka (~1980) and Thaba-Tseka itself are drawn from the 1986 census. Müller-Crepon DVN/9JI06R has Basutoland only in 1937 and as a single unit, so it does not answer the districts. Independent check (①): atom area / statoids area — Berea 1,991/2,222 = 0.896, Butha-Buthe 1,790/1,767 = 1.013, Leribe 2,824/2,828 = 0.999, Mafeteng 2,385/2,119 = 1.126, Maseru 4,049/4,279 = 0.946, Mohale's Hoek 3,427/3,530 = 0.971, Mokhotlong 4,200/4,075 = 1.031, Qacha's Nek 2,134/2,349 = 0.908, Quthing 2,966/2,916 = 1.017, Thaba-Tseka 4,820/4,270 = 1.129 (statoids' Thaba-Tseka figure is the sum of the four transferred parts; the gb ADM2 constituencies of a different publisher give Thaba-Tseka ≈ 4,870 km² as well, so the OSM lines are not the outlier there).
